This '''planet''' was the location of the [[Wilds (corvaj)|Wilds]], a [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] overgrown [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]. A [[Unidentified settlement (Ranna Gorjaye)|settlement]] was located seventeen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the Wilds. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] had a native predator, the [[corvaj]]. During a training patrol, [[Ranna Gorjaye]] and [[Calson]] crashed on the planet after Calson crowded the formation and clipped Gorjaye's wing. Calson was killed by a corvaj after refusing to follow Gorjaye's commands on the ground.<ref name="SC" />
